description: Finds the line number of the third successful production deployment in one long deploy history where a canary environment and a partial result are look-alikes. DISTILL-CANARY-96d9ba03

files.release/README.md:
# Deploy history

deploys.dat lists every deployment, semicolon separated, no header: ts;env;result;ver;note, one deployment per line.
env and result are whole values: `prod-canary` is not `prod`, and `OK-PARTIAL` is not a finished `OK`.

turns.prompt: In release/deploys.dat, which line holds the third deployment with env prod and result OK? release/README.md defines both values; reply with the line number.
